observations: L04, L05, L06, L07, L11, L14, L17, L18, L19, L21: long joins (النهـار, علامـة, هـذه, عليـه, عنـد, مغربـه, هـذا, مطلـع, بموضعـه, خُـذْ, الارتفـاع) are not transcribed.

The overlined letters are the points of the figure on p. 35; each has its own bar (on L03 the bar over ه printed in two pieces), «ا ب ج د» on L13 stand under one bar, and ص on L18 is the abjad numeral 90. A wider space stands after «ا ب ج د» on L13.
L02: وتُجرّ: a damma over the tā' and a shadda over the rā', with the reference to note 1 after it. نقطتيْ: a sukun over the yā'. خطًّا: shadda and fathatan.
L03: «أبدًا» as printed: a hamza over the alif and a fathatan over the dāl (1800 dpi). L01 ثم, L06 ثم and L17 ثم have no shadda; ثمّ on L13, L18 and L19 has one.

L04, L07: وٱرصُد and وٱعدُد have the waṣla over the alif (a curl 3.2-3.6 x 2.9-3.2 pt) and a damma over the ṣād and over the first dāl; فارصُد (L21) has the damma and no sign over the alif (3000 dpi).
L06: الرُبْع: a damma over the rā' and a sukun over the bā', no shadda (3000 dpi). العَمود: a fatha over the ʿayn. «الموري» ends with a dotted yā' on L03, L05, L06 and L22, as on p. 35.

L08, L09: عمِلْتَ: a kasra under the mīm, a sukun over the lām, a fatha over the tā'. In الوقت the top of the alif printed apart (1.1 x 5.0 pt). فأَخْرِجْ: a hamza with a fatha over the alif; over the khā' its dot (low) and a sukun above it; a kasra under the rā' and a sukun over the jīm (3000 dpi). ورَبِّعْ: a fatha, a shadda with a kasra, a sukun.
L10: حينئذٍ: a hamza over the tooth and a kasratan under the dhāl.
L14, L21: ميْلَ: a sukun over the yā' and a fatha over the lām.
L15: يتهيّأ: a shadda over the yā' and a hamza over the alif; the reference to note 3 after it. الّا has a shadda, printed high (-15 pt).
L16: بأنْ: a hamza alone over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt); over the nūn its dot (low, -6 to -4 pt) and a sukun above it (-14 to -11 pt; 3000 dpi).
L19, L20: شرَطْنا, خُذْ, مجموعيْن: as printed. L22: ظل has no shadda.
